sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions authorizing the city of Syracuse to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions authorizing the city of Syracuse to impose a hotel and motel tax to December 31, 2029.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York telecommunications relay service center
sponsored.sum: Restructures the New York telecommunications relay service center as a state-wide workforce; extends provisions of law authorizing the establishment of such workforce from June 30, 2027 until June 30, 2030.

sponsored.t: Establishes a comprehensive study of highway construction and maintenance worker safety
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of transportation to conduct a comprehensive study of highway construction and maintenance worker safety; directs the department to gather feedback from stakeholders; requires the department to submit a report on its findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration
sponsored.sum: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of road salt
sponsored.sum: Requires that the department of transportation and every municipality, locality and public authority shall not spread road salt at a rate higher than three hundred pounds per lane mile on average during each snow and ice management season.

sponsored.t: Relates to driver education
sponsored.sum: Adds courses at a licensed New York state driving school approved by the commissioner of motor vehicles to the list of driver education providers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the central New York regional transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Increases the membership of the central New York regional transportation authority from twelve to thirteen members.

sponsored.t: Relates to warranties and sales incentives
sponsored.sum: Requires every franchisor, including its affiliates and subsidiaries to properly fulfill any warranty agreement and/or franchisor's service contract and to compensate each of its franchised motor vehicle dealers for warranty parts and labor, including but not limited to all warranty repairs, extended service contract repairs, extended warranty repairs, campaigns, service bulletins, policy repairs, component part warranties, factory compensated repairs, recalls, diagnostics, parts and other voluntary stop-sell repairs, and any other franchisor compensated repairs; relates to reimbursement to a motor vehicle dealer from a motor vehicle franchisor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the storage of road salt
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of transportation and every municipality, locality and public authority that distributes road salt to construct a salt shed within ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services
sponsored.sum: Requires the clear and conspicuous disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services; imposes a fine of not more than one hundred dollars for the first offense and not more than two hundred fifty dollars for a second and each subsequent offense for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of license plates for disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of license plates for persons rated one hundred percent disabled by the United States department of veterans affairs.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum educational requirements of certain town and village justices
sponsored.sum: Establishes minimum educational requirements of certain town and village justices.

sponsored.t: Relates to the consumer protection division in the department of state
sponsored.sum: Requires the consumer protection division to establish a process by which any state agency or third party, pursuant to an interagency agreement with the division for the purposes of fraud prevention, identity verification, and ensuring the integrity or security of individual identities, to grant access to verify New York resident identities via a secure comparison process against state systems.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study to examine and update the requirements of safety inspections conducted to ensure the operational safety of all motor vehicles; requires a report; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Increases the weight limits for vehicles powered primarily by electric battery power and other fuels
sponsored.sum: Provides that a vehicle or a combination of vehicles operated by an engine fueled primarily by means of natural gas, propane gas, or hydrogen or powered primarily by means of electric battery power may exceed certain weight limits by up to two thousand pounds.

sponsored.t: Relates to pre-trip safety checks for charter buses
sponsored.sum: Requires motor carriers that operate charter buses to have pre-trip safety briefings on the mandatory use of safety belts by passengers and fines for such violations.

sponsored.t: Requires the chair of the public service commission create rules, regulations, policies, and procedures for the creation of a resilient electric vehicle charging system pilot program
sponsored.sum: Requires the chair of the public service commission create rules, regulations, policies, and procedures for the creation of a resilient electric vehicle charging system pilot program to provide power through an extended outage.

sponsored.t: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

sponsored.t: Relates to winter road maintenance data collection and monitoring
sponsored.sum: Establishes a standardized statewide system for collecting, recording, and monitoring winter road maintenance operational data in order to improve efficiency, enhance transparency, and support the protection of water resources in the state of New York; requires calibration of all deicing material application equipment used for winter highway maintenance on public roads.

sponsored.t: Relates to public notice and hearing prior to the imposition of new fees or surcharges by the New York state thruway authority
sponsored.sum: Requires public notice and hearing prior to the imposition of new fees, surcharges, or material change by the New York state thruway authority.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement for registration stickers on certain motor vehicles and provides for the issuance of electronic certificates of registration for certain motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement for registration stickers on certain motor vehicles; provides for the issuance of electronic certificates of registration for certain motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Requires bus drivers complete a human trafficking recognition training program
sponsored.sum: Requires bus drivers complete a human trafficking recognition training program which includes the nature of human trafficking; how human trafficking is defined in law; how to identify someone who is human trafficking; how to identify someone who is a human trafficking victim; and entities to whom a driver may report suspected activity that might constitute human trafficking.

sponsored.t: Relates to the solicitation of donations on state highways
sponsored.sum: Relates to solicitation of donations on state highways.

sponsored.t: Establishes a supplemental motor vehicle registration fee for counties outside the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District
sponsored.sum: Establishes a $25 annual supplemental motor vehicle registration fee for counties outside the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District; dedicates the revenue to upstate public transportation systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain signal devices for railroad trains or other on-track equipment
sponsored.sum: Requires whenever any person driving a vehicle approaches a railroad grade crossing where there is on-track equipment, the driver of such vehicle shall stop not less than fifteen feet from the nearest rail of such railroad, and shall not proceed until they can do so safely.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the lease of certain lands at SUNY college of environmental science and forestry for the purpose of building undergraduate and graduate student housing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state university of New York trustees are hereby authorized and empowered, without any public bidding, to lease and otherwise contract to make available to the Abby Lane Housing Corporation, a not-for-profit corporation, a portion of the lands of the university for the purpose of building undergraduate and graduate student housing.

sponsored.t: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras
sponsored.sum: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras and the adjudication of traffic infractions related thereto.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of an electronic signature on documents submitted to the New York state department of taxation and finance; repealer
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to develop procedures for the use or acceptance of signatures in digital or other electronic form on any declaration, statement, or other document utilized by the department and authorizes the use of an electronic signature by a person granted a power of attorney by a taxpayer with respect to documents submitted to the New York state department of taxation and finance.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring utility pole owners and attachers to submit an annual report on pole attachments; repeals provisions relating to right-of-way permits
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring utility pole owners and attachers to submit an annual report on pole attachments; repeals certain provisions relating to requirements for right-of-way permits.

sponsored.t: Relates to litigation funding
sponsored.sum: Amends the litigation funding act to promote consumer protections related to litigation funding contracts; provides for contract requirements for litigation funding including disclosures, prohibitions; provides for litigation funding company registration and reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Transportation services for certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to transportation services for the school districts of the cities of Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse and Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of photo speed violation monitoring systems in highway construction or maintenance work areas on all highways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of photo speed violation monitoring systems in highway construction or maintenance work areas on all highways in the state.

sponsored.t: Provides technical corrections to provisions concerning the adjudication of certain traffic violations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides technical corrections to provisions concerning the adjudication of certain traffic violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain criminal penalties for driving while impaired by alcohol or drugs
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain criminal penalties involving required alcohol and drug rehabilitation for driving while impaired by alcohol or drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for children for services related to the diagnosis and treatment of mental, nervous or emotional disorders or ailments
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for services related to the diagnosis and treatment of mental, nervous or emotional disorders or ailments; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Repeals article 21 of the tax law relating to imposition of a highway use tax for the privilege of operating any vehicular unit upon the public highways
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to imposition of a highway use tax for the privilege of operating any vehicular unit upon the public highways of the state.

sponsored.t: Requires the return of certain financial assistance provided for a project where the project has material shortfalls or material violations and preventing the use of incentives for projects already in development
sponsored.sum: Requires the return of all or a part of the financial assistance provided for a project where the project has material shortfalls or material violations; prevents the use of funds, financial incentives, subsidies or tax exemptions for projects already in development.

sponsored.t: Permits persons 65 years of age to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition
sponsored.sum: Permits persons 65 years of age or over to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition.

sponsored.t: Provides for the award of scholarships and loan forgiveness for nurses on the same terms as physicians
sponsored.sum: Provides for the award of regents scholarships and loan forgiveness for nurses on the same terms as physicians; applies to registered professional nurses as defined in section 6903 of the education law.

sponsored.t: Relates to driver's license lists and operating record information
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of motor vehicles may contract with private companies or public entities to provide lists of driver's license and partial operating records maintained and collected by the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of types of replacement parts used in automobile collision repairs
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose types of replacement parts used in automobile collision repairs and provides a disclosure form to be signed by the owner consenting to the use of any such parts; forbids use of any other parts except new original equipment manufacturer parts on any vehicle during the first year of its manufacture and for the two years following.

sponsored.t: Relates to vision screening in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires vision screening in public schools using examination devices and testing methods as may be authorized in the regulations of the commissioner of education, including but not limited to, the Snellen Eye Test Chart and automated vision screening devices.

sponsored.t: Relates to the furnishing of registration information by the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to the furnishing of registration information by the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maintenance of a database on intellectual property
sponsored.sum: Relates to the maintenance of a database on intellectual property generated by state employees or developed through state-funded research which shall include, at a minimum, a brief description of the intellectual property and up-to-date contact information for each item.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study relating to airborne ultrafine particles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study relating to airborne ultrafine particles; analyzes the impacts of certain large hub commercial airports on airborne ultrafine particles; analyzes the characteristics of such particles; identifies effectiveness of mitigation measures.

sponsored.t: Establishes the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program
sponsored.sum: Creates the child care professionals loan forgiveness incentive program for applicants who agree to engage in employment in the child care field; establishes the eligibility for such awards; establishes the amount and duration of such awards.

sponsored.t: Relates to the certification of certain property complying with the residential-commercial urban exemption program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the certification of certain property complying with the residential-commercial urban exemption program and the revocation of benefits of such program in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards and in-line skates who are under 18 years of age to wear protective headgear
sponsored.sum: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards, inline skates and scooters who are under eighteen years of age to wear protective headgear; increases the age requirement from fourteen years to eighteen years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the license requirements for the practice of respiratory therapy
sponsored.sum: Relates to the license requirements for the practice of respiratory therapy; requires additional education.

sponsored.t: Relates to modernizing and increasing the transparency of local government procurement of goods and services
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "local government procurement modernization and transparency act" to modernize and increase the transparency of local government procurement of goods and services; allows a political subdivision to provide notice of requests for bids by posting the requests on the New York state contract reporter website; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides for the detailing of the benefits and costs of proposed rules in the regulatory impact statements
sponsored.sum: Provides for the detailing of the benefits and costs of proposed rules in the regulatory impact statements to ensure proper disclosure to the public of such information.

sponsored.t: Relates to the meaning of the term "newspaper" for purposes of publishing certain notices required by law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the meaning of the term "newspaper" for purposes of publishing certain notices required by law.

sponsored.t: Requires compliance with collision repair guidelines and service bulletins issued by vehicle or original equipment manufacturers
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the repair of a collision damaged motor vehicle, no motor vehicle repair shop or insurer shall deviate from the collision repair guidelines, procedures, recommendations and service bulletins issued by a vehicle or original equipment manufacturer without the written authorization from the vehicle owner or such owner's representative.

sponsored.t: Authorizes recoupment of financial incentives awarded businesses upon failure to fulfill the terms of such incentive
sponsored.sum: Authorizes recoupment by the state or any political subdivision of financial incentives such as awards, loans, grants or tax abatements, awarded businesses for purposes of job training, job creation or retention, or the development of business operations, upon recipient's failure to complete the terms of the incentive.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater from $20,000 to $25,000 in 2027, $30,000 in 2028, $35,000 in 2029 and $40,000 for each subsequent year.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulating the use of unmanned aircraft in the state
sponsored.sum: Regulates the use of unmanned aircrafts in the state; defines terms; authorizes permitted uses of unmanned aircrafts; restricts use of unmanned aircrafts; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires certain training for all retailers, dealers and sellers of firearms in New York state
sponsored.sum: Requires training on how to identify illegal purchasers of firearms for all retailers, dealers and sellers of firearms in New York state; directs the state police to implement such program; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to consolidated local highway assistance payments
sponsored.sum: Provides that whenever the estimate for construction work exceeds one hundred thousand dollars but does not exceed seven hundred fifty thousand dollars such work must be performed either with the municipality's own forces or by contract let by competitive bid.

sponsored.t: Relates to recovering attorney fees for legal services rendered under certain claims
sponsored.sum: Relates to the cost for legal services in connection with any claim arising under the volunteer firefighter's benefit law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of additional orders of protection when reviewing an extreme risk protection order
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a supreme court judge hearing a petition for an "extreme risk protection order" to also hear a petition for a regular order of protection pursuant to the criminal procedure law, the domestic relations law and/or the family court act.

sponsored.t: Provides for the electronic transmission of certain documents
sponsored.sum: Provides for the electronic transmission of vehicle certificate of titles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears
sponsored.sum: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears; provides that all shelter arrears payments authorized for applicants to receive an emergency grant to pay for rent, property taxes or mortgage arrears shall be limited to once every year unless the district determines at its discretion that additional shelter arrears payments are necessary based on the individual circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of rates of payment and delivery of health care services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of rates of payment and delivery of health care services; directs the chair of the workers' compensation board to biennially prepare and establish a schedule of fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to county committee designations of candidates for certain offices
sponsored.sum: Relates to party nominations for candidates for office, excluding counties located within cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Repeals title 2 of article 14 of the election law, relating to public financing
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to public financing.

sponsored.t: Relates to campaign contributions by a limited liability company
sponsored.sum: Provides that for contributions that exceed twenty-five hundred dollars, when a campaign contribution is attributed to a limited liability company, such contributions shall be further attributed to each member of the limited liability company in proportion to the member's ownership interest in the limited liability company.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing penalties for endangerment of a highway worker, promote work zone safety awareness, and establish a fund for additional work zone safety enforcement
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for endangerment of a highway worker; promotes work zone safety awareness; establishes a fund for additional work zone safety enforcement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the individuals who are required to file New York state income tax returns
sponsored.sum: Amends the threshold of resident individuals required to file New York state income tax returns.

sponsored.t: Provides that any service outside of N.Y. city, that is designated as a microtransit service shall be eligible for statewide mass transportation operating assistance regard
sponsored.sum: Provides that any service outside of a city with a population of more than one million, that is designated as a microtransit service shall be eligible for statewide mass transportation operating assistance regardless of vehicle size; defines "microtransit service" to mean a technology-enabled on-demand service with dynamically generated routing that uses a managed fleet of multi-passenger vehicles dedicated to that service.

sponsored.t: Relates to hiring and promoting employees on a permanent basis at municipal and/or authority owned or operated airports
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the hiring and promotion of employees on a permanent basis at municipal and/or authority owned or operated airports.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prevents certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority.

sponsored.t: Authorizes bail for principals charged with certain driving while intoxicated offenses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail for principals charged with certain driving while intoxicated offenses.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 901 of the real property tax law relating to unpaid housing code violation penalties in the city of Syracuse
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to unpaid housing code violation penalties in the city of Syracuse.

sponsored.t: Prohibits insurers from limiting payment on claims based on pricing caps and from recommending a particular repair facility
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurers from limiting payment on claims for damage to motor vehicles based on pricing caps for labor, parts, paint or repair materials; prohibits insurers from recommending a particular repair facility.

sponsored.t: Extends the provisions of chapter 3 of the laws of 2020 relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to establishing the stretch limousine passenger safety task force; authorizes the stretch limousine passenger safety task force to continue to hold public hearings and meetings to review the actions taken by the state and to publish a report of its findings.

sponsored.t: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented five times within an eighteen month period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure to comply with traffic-control indications
sponsored.sum: Suspends the registration of a vehicle which has been documented five times within an eighteen month period by a photo violation monitoring device for failure of an operator thereof to comply with traffic-control indications for a period of ninety days.

sponsored.t: Relates to the execution of certificates by persons conducting business under assumed names or as partners
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that each certificate be duly acknowledged by the person or persons conducting business.

sponsored.t: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation, and department of transportation about certain freight rail trains
sponsored.sum: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation and department of transportation about freight rail trains transporting hazardous materials prior to traveling on tracks within the state.

sponsored.t: Directs telecommunication and cable corporations to provide call center service assistance from centers located within the state
sponsored.sum: Directs telecommunications and cable corporations to provide call center service assistance from centers located within the state and such corporations' service areas; includes a list of what services must be provided.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of aggravated threat of mass harm in the first degree and aggravated threat of mass harm in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of aggravated threat of mass harm in the first degree and aggravated threat of mass harm in the second degree; makes such crimes hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game
sponsored.sum: Allows the use of unmanned aerial vehicles in tracking big game that are dead, wounded or injured.

sponsored.t: Includes red cross vehicles as authorized emergency vehicles
sponsored.sum: Adds red cross vehicles to the definition of authorized emergency vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to compensation of members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Provides that in years where a pay period occurs on January first of such year, the salaries of members of the legislature shall be payable in twenty-seven bi-weekly payments.

sponsored.t: Relates to hourly compensation and reimbursement for representation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the hourly compensation and reimbursement rate for representation to be subject to an annual cost of living increase as governed by the United States Criminal Justice Act; provides that all hourly rates shall be increased automatically each year in accordance with any federal pay comparability adjustment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village and authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of town machinery, tools and equipment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village; authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of certain services and town machinery, tools and equipment with another municipality, district corporation, school district, community college or any unit of the state university.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures relating to driving while ability impaired by drugs
sponsored.sum: Relates to procedures relating to driving while ability impaired by drugs; defines impairment and intoxication; updates procedures for field testing of drivers suspected of being under the influence of drugs to include the use of oral/bodily fluid tests; provides that refusal to submit to such field tests is specified to be a traffic infraction; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates photo speed violation monitoring systems in a highway construction or maintenance work area; makes permanent
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of photo speed violation monitoring systems in a highway construction or maintenance work area; makes such provisions permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to multiple violations of the highway construction or maintenance work area photo speed violation monitoring system
sponsored.sum: Suspends the registration of vehicles which have been documented multiple times by a photo speed violation monitoring system for speeding in a highway construction or maintenance work area.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for certain speed violations
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for certain speed violations.

sponsored.t: Fines imposed for failure to move over
sponsored.sum: Imposes fines for failure to exercise due care and move over when approaching parked, stopped or standing motor vehicles on the shoulder of a highway.

sponsored.t: Relates to the suspension and revocation of certain learner's permits and the return of numbered plates and registration suspensions in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides for the suspension and revocation of certain learner's permits, and the return of numbered plates and registration suspensions in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requiring that vehicles yield the right of way to multi-use trails that cross roadways
sponsored.sum: Requires that vehicles yield the right of way to multi-use trails that cross roadways.

sponsored.t: Requires police reports of traffic accidents to include insurance information for the parties to the accident
sponsored.sum: Requires police reports of traffic accidents to include insurance information for the parties to the accident.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to certain employees of the department of public safety of the Syracuse city school district
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to certain employees of the department of public safety of the Syracuse city school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure to stop at a stop sign or yield for a pedestrian
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a municipality to adopt a local law or ordinance to establish a program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator to install and operate stop sign and pedestrian crossing photo violation monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures relating to driving while ability impaired by drugs
sponsored.sum: Alters the definition of "drug" to include any substance or combination of substances that impair, to any extent, physical or mental abilities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain school districts and their municipalities to authorize a one-time annual increase to the amount of school district expenditures funded by city funds to be excluded from certain calculations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain school districts and their municipalities to sign a memorandum of understanding authorizing a one-time annual increase to the amount of school district expenditures funded by city funds to be excluded from the maintenance of effort calculation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state vehicle security circumvention device act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state vehicle security circumvention device act" to prohibit the manufacturing, sale, offering to sell, or possession of devices outside of lawful and reasonable purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of transportation to provide a list of legal clearance heights for bridges to certain drivers
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to provide a list of legal clearance heights for bridges to owners or operators of trucks, commercial vehicles, tractors, tractor-trailer combinations, tractor-semitrailer combinations, or tractor-trailer-semitrailer combinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the determination of the existence and amount of surplus
sponsored.sum: Removes provisions of law where a tax district has sold or conveyed a tax-foreclosed property to a land bank, a housing development agency or another public entity and the sale or conveyance was not the result or a public sale.

sponsored.t: Relates to consumer litigation funding
sponsored.sum: Enacts the consumer litigation funding act to promote consumer protections related to consumer litigation funding transactions; provides for contract requirements, including that the contract contain a no penalty provision for the prepayment of the funded amount prior to the settlement of their case; makes related provisions.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 29 Chapter 645 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 804-C, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to consumer litigation funding" APPROVED The bill increases protections for individuals who engage in consumer litigation funding transactions, by creating a regulatory structure for such transactions, including standardized contractual terms, mandatory disclosure requirements, and registration requirements. I support the goals of ensuring that individuals who enter into liti- gation funding agreements to advance their legal claims are afforded key consumer protections, including standardized and mandatory disclosures of the funded amount, repayment framework and limits on charges. The bill as drafted required amendments to make clear, among other things, the required disclosures and contractual rights/duties as well as the…

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study to examine and update the requirements of safety inspections conducted to ensure the operational safety of all motor vehicles; requires a report; makes related provisions.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 56 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Onondaga county sheriff's department to offer the optional twenty year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Onondaga county sheriff's department, in the county of Onondaga, to offer the optional twenty year retirement plan to deputy sheriffs Brittany E. Dorn, Noah C. Hunt, Daniel D. Lorenzini, Gordon J. Lopez, Tre C. Fesinger, and Christopher L. Van Dusen.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Syracuse regional airport authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to the powers of the Syracuse regional airport authority; provides that the Syracuse regional airport authority shall determine which positions, with the exception of all police positions, shall be in the exempt class of civil service.

sponsored.t: Relates to peremptory challenges where there are two or more defendants
sponsored.sum: Provides that if there is a tie when there is an even number of defendants, a peremptory challenge must be allowed.

sponsored.t: Relates to pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services
sponsored.sum: Requires the clear and conspicuous disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services; imposes a fine of not more than one hundred dollars for the first offense and not more than two hundred fifty dollars for a second and each subsequent offense for violations.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 26 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 1096-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to the disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services" NOT APPROVED This bill would amend the General Business Law to require food retail- ers and third-party delivery platforms to disclose whether the prices listed online or on the platform are greater than, lower than, or the same as the in-store price. I support the goals of facilitating a consumer's ability to make informed choices when shopping. However, amongst other concerns, the requirement to share the comparative in-store pricing information to the delivery or online platforms in real time would be operationally chal- lenging, particularly for retails with multiple locations, and may lead to…

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Onondaga to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Onondaga to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes from November 30, 2025 until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to enforcement of pole attachment safety and quality
sponsored.sum: Relates to enforcement of pole attachment safety and quality and utility pole and attachment identification.

sponsored.t: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville
sponsored.sum: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain students attending the Syracuse Comprehensive Education and Workforce Training Center high school to be eligible for senior high school athletic competitions
sponsored.sum: Authorizes students attending the Syracuse Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics high school, who participated in a high school athletic competition for a school district other than the Syracuse city school district in 7th and/or 8th grade, to be eligible for senior high school athletic competitions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Baldwinsville
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax of up to 5% in the village of Baldwinsville, county of Onondaga.

sponsored.t: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of an electronic signature by a person granted a power of attorney with respect to tax documents submitted
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of an electronic signature by a person granted a power of attorney by a taxpayer with respect to documents submitted to the New York state department of taxation and finance and the New York city department of finance.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.
